A One stop destination for Samosa, Dhokla, Fafda, Jalebi, Mango milkshake(seasonal), sweets, farsan, snacks, Gujarati food and a lot more.

Things we ordered:

Samosa-Yummy hot and fresh. You can Try their samosa pav and vada Pav too.

Chinese Samosa- we loved this. Make sure it's hot when served.

Paneer roll- we didn't like this much. Would've been better if served hot.

Khandvi- not a khandvi fan but really liked this. You should try it even if you don't like gujju food.

Jalebi and Fafda- this place is well known for its jalebi and Fafda. Must

featured_reviews.review_text: The snacks were fresh, crispy, and full of authentic flavor, while the sweets were perfectly balanced and delicious. Great taste, good quality, and consistent freshness — definitely a go-to place for traditional snacks and mithai.

featured_reviews.name: Darshan Singh Manral
featured_reviews.review_text: Jaslok Sweets & Farsan is a great place for fast food and sweets at reasonable rates. The quality and taste are really good. Their samosa is super tasty — crispy outside with delicious filling. The dhokla is also very soft, fresh, and full of flavor. Service is quick and the overall experience is nice. Sometimes there can be a rush because the shop is very famous, but the food is definitely worth the wait. Highly recommended for snacks and sweets lovers!

featured_reviews.review_text: They offer a variety of sweets, farsan, and snacks with delicious flavors. I tried their Rasmalai, which was incredibly soft and perfectly sweet. In the evening, the shop tends to get quite crowded. It's a well-known shop in Andheri East.

featured_reviews.name: Sumit Lalwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this place yesterday in the evening, was craving for choley bhature. It's located near evershine mall, Malad West.
The seating area is small and comfortable.

I ordered for Chholay bhature and kulcha which comes in whole wheat and maida. They serve three types of kulcha along with chholay. The taste was really authentic, i totally loved the way it was served Along with onion, pickle and green chutney.

Then I tried their Rajma chawal which was another fantastic dish, a complete comfort food, feels like homemade. The quality was amazing.

And finally the Chaas and Kesar Rabdi kheer which was so satisfying after this delicious meal.

Service was really good and the Staff Mr. Manish hosted us really good.
Must try out this place if you are around Evershine mall.

featured_reviews.name: Virendra Kumawat
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place just attracted to me by its name. I've been looking for chholay and kulche since long time and I saw this outlet so decided to visit.

I tried, Kulche and chholay it was really good and delicious in taste. It had achar, onions and chutney in it served along with butter milk. The speciality is this place serve in leaf plate which i really loved.

The rajma chawal and jeera was also amazing. 😍😍

The Kesar rabdi kheer was really good. The taste and the quality was on point. The perfect indian dessert.

The service was amazing and taste was on point.
Really worth visiting this place.

featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent experience at Trupti Sweet & Farsan was extremely disappointing and concerning. If you are visiting based on positive experiences from the past, please be cautious. This place no longer maintains the same quality or standards.

I would strongly advise against bulk purchases, whether for personal use or for gifting to friends and family.

I bought a bulk quantity of Banana (Kela) Mari wafers, but the items I received were clearly old stock. The wafers were stale, overly oily, poorly seasoned, and some packets even contained leftover yellow banana wafers mixed in. This clearly indicated a lack of quality control and freshness.

When I tried to raise this issue, the owner, Bhavesh Patel, did not respond to any calls/WhatsApp or follow-ups, which was extremely unprofessional. The staff member present at the store, Jainishbhai, was also unusually rude, something I have never experienced before in the food industry.

Despite sharing proof and following up multiple times, they refused to acknowledge the issue or replace the products.

Overall, this experience reflects poor product quality, rude behavior, and a complete lack of accountability. I cannot recommend this place to anyone looking for reliable quality or trustworthy service.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Sweet Bengal: A Must-Visit for Bengali Mithai Lovers

If you’re a fan of traditional Bengali sweets, Sweet Bengal is an absolute must-visit. From the moment you walk in, the warm and attentive service sets the tone for a delightful experience.

I couldn't resist trying the Mango Chomchom—a perfect fusion of my two favorites, chomchom and mango. It was everything I hoped for: sweet, creamy, and bursting with flavor.

Next up was the classic Mishti Doi, served in a charming earthen pot. The creamy, rich texture was indulgent, and you could tell it was made with care. Truly a treat for the senses.

I also had to ask about their Samosa and Kachori—I’m always curious about the freshness of these fried snacks. The staff was honest and told me they were made fresh in the morning. I was glad to hear it, because both lived up to their reputation.

The Samosa had the perfect crispy shell and a flavorful, spiced filling, complemented by a tangy chutney that made each bite even better. But it was the Kachori that truly stole the show—it had the best filling I’ve ever tasted, rich and savory with a delicious kick.

In short, Sweet Bengal isn’t just about sweets; it's a full Bengali culinary experience. As we say in Bengal... Ami tumake bhalo bashi

featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're in Santacruz and craving something refreshing and authentic, Banarasi Sweet Mart near the metro station is a must-visit! Stopped by with my friends, and we tried their Lassi and Dahi Bada—both were absolutely delicious!

The Lassi was thick, creamy, and perfectly sweetened, which added to the experience. It was so rich and refreshing that one glass felt like a full meal in itself! The Dahi Bada was soft, melt-in-the-mouth, and loaded with flavorful chutneys and spices, making every bite a perfect balance of sweet, tangy, and spicy.

The place has a simple, no-fuss setup but serves some of the best desi treats in town. If you're a fan of North Indian sweets and snacks, this spot won’t disappoint. Definitely coming back for another round soon! 💯✨
